analysis: No concrete security regression found in the visible source. 1) ClusterPlacementTensorAssistantSelection.swift:46-48 adds discoveryMode(). It maps MTPMode.auto to .off for coordinator-serving plans, so the unqualified speculative assistant is not quoted or offered there. This narrows attack surface and matches the stated T-054/T-056 posture. An explicit `on` is preserved, and the comment says the leader refuses the coordinator's approval. That refusal and the caller wiring (ClusterConfiguration.tensorAssistantServesLocally) are not in the supplied evidence, so I could not check them. 2) EngineV2Reslice.swift:81-118 adds floors-first KV re-slicing. I checked the arithmetic: floors are max(1 GiB, per-slot value), so they are never negative. UInt64 addition uses overflow reporting, and the `total <= budget` guard holds before `budget - floorTotal`. The summed grants are floors plus a remainder of at most budget minus floorTotal, so the sum stays at most the budget, which keeps the sum-of-grants invariant. If the sum of floors exceeds the budget, the old proportional result is returned and resliceMeetsServiceabilityFloor still refuses the load. The newcomer carries only the base floor, as before. The change affects availability only; no secrecy or authorization effect and no new input from consumers. 3) ChatRequest.swift:41-47 is comment-only. It says min_p is now applied on single-Mac v2 via EngineV2Bridge and that MiMo native media and Nemotron Super refuse non-zero values. The bridge and sampler code are not supplied, so that behavior and its input bounds are unverified. min_p is a sampling hint and not an authorization or confidentiality surface. 4) ProviderLoop+EngineV2.swift has only metadata and a truncated patch excerpt, with no numbered source unit. The visible hunks are a refactor that passes minimumGrantBytes into resliceGrants in both the unload-regrow and load paths. The rest of the changed ranges (around lines 423-455, 554-562, 657-670) were not visible, so the LOAD-time use of the new grants is not fully reviewed. Integration should check that the actual engine KV ceilings applied match the returned grants and never exceed the fleet budget.
